figures.finding: The age of majority in Lesotho is eighteen; everyone under eighteen is a minor.

sources.said: 3A. Age of majority The age of majority in Lesotho is eighteen years. Every person who has not yet attained eighteen years of age is a minor.

figures.finding: No exception for performing appears in the Children's Protection and Welfare Act's employment part as served in excerpts: the minimum age for employment is fifteen and light work is open from thirteen, so a child performer under thirteen is barred and from thirteen limited to light work, as any child's work, writing or directing included (a reading: the Act wasn't read whole).

sources.said: (1) The minimum age for admission of a child to employment shall be fifteen years ... . (2) No person shall employ a child below the minimum age of fifteen years.
(1) Notwithstanding section 228 , a child who is thirteen years or above may be ... engaged in light work .

figures.finding: A person under eighteen may not be appointed a director of a company (excerpt of the Companies Act, 2011, s. 57, as LesothoLII's search serves it; the section wasn't read whole).

sources.said: 57. Qualifications of directors … of a company — (a) a body corporate; (b) a person who is under 18 years of age
